en:
Wait just a minute, Tenko wasn't sitting
down inside the cage.

She was <CLT=cltSTRONG>bent over<CLT=cltNORMAL> with her
forehead against the <CLT=cltSTRONG>marker stone<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
And the cage itself was about three feet tall.

The sickle's blade was too short to reach
Tenko while she was in that position.

Then...I messed up again? How could
this happen? I'm so embarrassed...

No worries, Miu! Everyone already knows
you're an embarrassment to the human race!
Yeah! No worries!
Heeeeeee! How...how embarrassing!

If Shuichi is right, then it's impossible for
Tenko to have been killed through the cage.

She couldn't have been killed during the 
seance since she was in the cage, right?

If she was killed then, the cloth over 
the cage would have been pierced.

Not during the seance or from below
the floor... Then it's impossible, isn't it?
...Yeah, for a living person.
Huh...?

Nee-heehee... What if Angie's spirit
killed Tenko?

Wh-What are you talking about!?
Th-Th-That's not possible!

We don't know that. Some things are
impossible for a human, but not for a spirit.

D-Don't say stupid stuff like that!
S-S-Screw spirits!
...Stop that now.
Angie's spirit...killed Tenko? Wh-Why...?
Himiko?
Why would Angie's spirit kill Tenko?

What if Tenko killed Angie, and then 
Angie's spirit came back for reven—

Like I said, that's impossible!
Spirits can't be culprits!

Then explain how the culprit killed Tenko
under these impossible circumstances.
W-Well, uh...

See? You can't explain, can you?
Only a spirit could have done th—

W-Wait, I know! What if the culprit 
was hiding inside the cage!?

If they were in there, they coulda
stabbed Tenko during the seance!

No, if there was someone else
in the cage, we would've noticed—

I agree with Kaito. The culprit could have
been inside the cage.
<CLT=cltMIND>...You do?

Nonsense. There was no space in
the cage for the culprit to hide.

Maybe the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> wouldn't need
to hide in the first place.
What?

Also, the culprit could've killed her in the
cage at any time.
I think you know what I'm getting at, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>The "they" she's
referring to...
Do you mean...Himiko?
Why are you suspecting me?
I would never kill Tenko!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Do you mean...Angie's ghost?

Can you stop thinking about such stupid
things?

Th-That's right! S-Spirits can't be
culprits...that's not how it works!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You really don't know? I thought at least a
detective like you could figure it out.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

...Wrong. Who could have killed Tenko
inside the cage at any time?

I don't get you. 
You're really narrow-minded for a detective.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Who could have killed Tenko
from inside the cage?

I believe Maki is referring to
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Tenko<CLT=cltNORMAL> herself.
Nyeh!? What did you say!?
Are you saying...Tenko is the culprit?
...She committed <CLT=cltSTRONG>suicide<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
S-Suicide!?

If she committed suicide, it would explain
a lot of things we couldn't figure out.

She volunteered to be in the cage, and then
stabbed herself during the seance.
It wouldn't matter how dark the room was.

But the sickle she was stabbed with
was under the floor, right?

If Tenko had stabbed herself, wouldn't the
sickle still be inside the cage?
O-Omigod! Miu actually said something smart!

Perhaps that explains why the
floorboard was removed.

After stabbing herself with the sickle,
she threw it underneath the floor.

So she took off the floorboard to
get rid of the sickle...?
Yes... That make sense to Gonta...
W-Well it doesn't make sense to me!
There's no reason for Tenko to commit suicide!

Maybe I wasn't too far off with the theory
I had earlier...
Y'know, about Tenko killing Angie?
Nyeh?

Because Tenko and Angie were fighting for
your attention, right?
Hey, Angie! When did you brainwash Himiko!?

Tenko's pent-up frustration led her to
commit such an atrocity...

Her conscience couldn't handle it anymore, 
so she decided to end her own life.
Wh-What...?

But...if she was gonna kill herself,
why do it during the seance?
She wanted to hide the truth of her suicide.
R-Really? Why?

There could only be one reason to hide it 
in a killing game, right?
It's to <CLT=cltSTRONG>take us down with her<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Take us down...?

She wanted us to pick the wrong
answer during the class trial...

...so she could bring us all down!
She wanted us to die with her!

Okay, well, she probably just wanted Himiko
to die with her. But still...

Wh-What are you saying?
Tenko...wasn't like that.
She told me...

Keep your chin up and live life facing forward!
Survive <CLT=cltSTRONG>with me and everyone else<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
What if all of that was just a lie?
A lie...?
Wait! We should believe Tenko's last words!

The true terror of class trials is that 
you shouldn't believe everything said.

Himiko, you said that Tenko would never
do anything like that...

But how can you be so sure?
Did you guys *actually* know each other?

People keep all sorts of secrets, like Maki. She
hid the fact that she's a cold-blooded killer.

Is it wise of us to trust other people
wholeheartedly in this kind of situation?
Geez...you're such a naive dude.
...Naive?

We're all just people, y'know? Of course
we're gonna have some secrets.

What matters is whether there's any malice
behind 'em.

People can lie about how malicious
their hidden secrets really are.

Well duh. It's impossible to know for
sure what others are thinking.

That's why it all comes down to whether 
or not you believe in yourself!

If you get betrayed, it's not their fault!
It's your fault for believing in them!

That's why I believed in Maki Roll!
Because I wanted to believe in her!

Just because you're acting all cool
doesn't mean you get to skip training.

H-Hey, c'mon... Don'tcha think you're
being a little too strict?

Well, we come from different backgrounds.
So for now, let's agree to disagree.

No one's ever called me naive before.
And from Kaito? Seriously?
Whether or not I believe...

My heart...can't reach Tenko anymore... 
But I wanna believe in her...

She wouldn't commit suicide!
She wouldn't try to take us down!
That's what I want to believe!

Me too. Gonta no can believe Tenko commit
suicide.

But if Tenko did commit suicide, that would
answer all of our questions.

If you insist we believe in Tenko,
then provide a reason to do so.
<CLT=cltMIND>A proper reason...
Alright...I'll give you a reason.
...Is there a reason?
Yes, there is. Will you trust me, Maki?

If it turns out I'm wrong, you can
blame me all you like.

But for now...I need you to trust
in my detective work.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't believe Tenko would kill
herself. Because of what she said...

Okay, everyone!
I'll see you guys after the seance!

<CLT=cltMIND>She said <CLT=cltSTRONG>"see you guys after."<CLT=cltMIND>
I doubt she had a sudden change of heart.

<CLT=cltMIND>Just because we don't know how she
was killed doesn't mean that it was suicide.

<CLT=cltMIND>We shouldn't be satisfied with that.
And if we keep thinking, we'll find the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>And that means...
we have to believe in Tenko!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll make them all believe!
